subject.en: Winking faceted buffalo with a plain muzzle and one rainbow flower sprig
subject.zh: 自然探头的切面水牛，眨眼表情与一枝彩色花叶

description.en: The face and flower sprig share a close portrait. A short natural neck enters through the lower frame, with room around the horns, ears, and the complete colorful gesture.
description.zh: 脸部与花枝组成紧凑的特写，短而自然的颈部从下方入画。牛角、耳朵和完整的彩色花枝四周留出空间，保留探头时的轻松神态。

description.en: Broad walnut and gold facets shape the head, curved horns, and relaxed shoulders. A plain muzzle keeps attention on the wink and the single mouth-held rainbow sprig.
description.zh: 胡桃棕与金色的大切面构成脸部、弯角和自然的肩线。鼻部保持干净，多彩装饰集中在嘴边的一枝花叶上。

description.en: Broken angular arches sit quietly in the warm mineral field. Fine grain and soft contact shadows give the flat facets a tactile setting.
description.zh: 断开的折线拱纹安静地铺在暖矿色底面上，细腻颗粒与柔和接触阴影，为平面的碎片带来触手可及的质感。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the broad golden horns, brown face, and colorful sprig carry the identity. At 16 px, the wink and separate petals simplify into the silhouette and a small rainbow accent.
sizeNote.zh: 在 32 px 下，宽阔的金色牛角、棕色脸部与彩色花枝承担辨识度。缩到 16 px 时，眨眼和独立花瓣会合并为轮廓与一小片彩色点缀。

goal.en: Keep reporting relationships, documents and revision history together in workspaces, with web and CLI access to the same knowledge base.
goal.zh: 围绕人物和工作空间整理组织关系、文档和版本记录，并用网页与命令行维护同一份知识库。

role.zh: 类型、工作区与本地开发

role.en: People, documents, revisions, fields and views
role.zh: 人物、文档、版本、字段与视图存储
服务端数据与页面导航

role.en: CLI generation from the API schema
role.zh: 从 API schema 生成 CLI

description.en: Broken polygonal arches recall the buffalo’s horns; their open ends leave the face and flower sprig in focus.
description.zh: 断开的多边形拱线取自水牛角的轮廓，开口朝向留白，让面孔与花枝保持醒目。

alt.en: Winking faceted buffalo with a plain muzzle and one rainbow flower sprig on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 自然探头的切面水牛，眨眼表情与一枝彩色花叶，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Winking faceted buffalo with a plain muzzle and one rainbow flower sprig.
description.zh: 自然探头的切面水牛，眨眼表情与一枝彩色花叶。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥54px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 54px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
